text:
marta: Heads-up — QLink wants a short, focused perf run next week on their Lumen-X accelerator. Goals: 1) perf/W curves across 8/16/32 batch sizes, 2) end-to-end throughput for our 4k token gen profile, 3) validate kernel patch that reduces mem copies. Can we align on inputs and telemetry?
qlink-pm: Thanks Marta — yep we can host. Primary constraints: single-rack access Tue/Wed, and we need your kernel + model container by EOD Monday. Who owns the config?
raj: I can own the Redwood side container + model. Need the exact kernel commit hash you want us to run against. Also, what's the target power envelope?
qlink-fw: For the kernel patch we plan to test two variants: v1 (cache coalesce) and v2 (async copy). We can publish the commit hashes tomorrow. Power envelope: 300W per card nominal, we'll sweep 150–300W.
kevin: On telemetry side we should collect: per-GPU power (W), host CPU util, p99 latency, tokens/sec, and per-step kernel times. Prefer JSON output to push into our bench pipeline.
daan: Can we add KV cache hit rate + prefix cache reuse metric? For conversational loads that's important.
qlink-fw: Yes KV stats we can export. We'll also push raw nvprof counters if you want deeper traces (will need extra storage).
marta: Storage ok. Also need to confirm embargo / joint announcement timing. Suggest we run private analyses, then share a joint results doc 48h after tests. No public numbers until both sides sign off.
qlink-pm: Agreed. NDA covers bench docs. We'll tag any press language as "partner-reviewed".
raj: Quick config snippet I'll push to the repo — please review:
```
MODEL=redwood-4k-gen:main
KERNEL_HASH=TODO
BATCH_SIZES=[8,16,32]
POWER_SWEEPS=[150,200,250,300]
METRICS=json:stdout
```
kevin: For the run harness use `./bench/run.sh --trace-level=perf --out=bench-results.json`. Benchbot can ingest that. Also flag: enable continuous-batching=false for the first pass so we can measure raw per-request latency.
benchbot: @channel benchbot will ingest `bench-results.json` automatically when it appears in /bench/artifacts and kick off the perf->telemetry pipeline. Reaction: :robot_face:.
qlink-fw: One more ask: during the v2 async copy test we may see transient errors on older infra. Can you allow retries in the harness (3x) and capture stack traces?
raj: Ok I'll add `--retries=3 --capture-traces` to the harness. We'll tag any flaky runs in the results.
kevin: Also add a seed set of 20 deterministic prompts for quality regression checks. We don't want quantization/kernel changes to regress outputs.
daan: I'll supply the prompt set and baseline outputs from last month. Put them in `/bench/inputs/regression-seed-2025-03-20.json`.
marta: Scheduling — QLink said Tue/Wed. Redwood ops can send a single engineer on Tue morning for handover. Who can go?
raj: I can be on Tue AM PST. Kevin can do Wed if needed.
qlink-pm: We'll reserve rack Tuesday 0900–1700 PT. Please be on the video call at 0845 for handoff.
kevin: I'll prep the monitor dashboards: perf/W heatmap, p99 trend, and kernel timeline. Share link before run.
marta: Perfect. Post-run checklist: raw artifacts shared, benchbot summary, joint writeup draft, and a quick sync to decide any public messaging. Everyone ok?
qlink-pm: Sounds good from our side. Looking forward to it.
raj: All set — pushing container + harness Monday EOD.
kevin: Dashboards ready.
daan: Prompt set uploaded.
marta: Thanks team — I'll create a calendar invite and attach the checklist. :thumbsup:
